counting_cardinality.evidence: Move or mark objects and connect the resulting quantity to its count.

oral_counting.evidence: Record the actual counting sequence; a parent checks omissions, order and the stated starting point.

numeral_formation.evidence: Form the requested numeral with actual pointer strokes; a parent checks the numeral and its value.

number_comparison.evidence: Arrange or connect numeric amounts according to their values, not their labels or presentation order.

place_value.evidence: Build and regroup amounts, showing the value represented by each place rather than only naming a digit.

arithmetic_actions.evidence: Change quantities by joining, separating, distributing or building groups, conserving the stated stock.

arithmetic_fluency.evidence: Give fresh arithmetic facts aloud without a worked model; a parent checks accuracy and fluent recall.

equal_groups.evidence: Pack, share or build equal groups from a shared stock; the final distribution demonstrates the operation.

calculation_algorithm.evidence: Build a calculation and record the intermediate algorithm or partial-product steps; a parent checks the method and answer.

mathematical_reasoning.evidence: Change a mathematical representation, then explain the relationship or strategy using actual written, drawn or spoken reasoning.

rounding_estimation.evidence: Place or compare an amount against benchmarks and select the approximation justified by its position.

patterns_expressions.evidence: Build an expression, continue a rule or connect related terms so the changed state follows the mathematical relationship.

fraction_models.evidence: Build, partition or locate fractional amounts using an explicitly identified whole and equal units.

fraction_equivalence.evidence: Split equal parts while preserving the same shaded whole and demonstrate the resulting equivalent fraction.

fraction_operations.evidence: Join, separate, share or scale rational units while retaining the same whole and exact fraction values.

measurement_length.evidence: Move a measurement marker or lay equal units against a visible object, using a visible scale and stated unit.

measurement_mass_capacity.evidence: Change a visible balance or graduated vessel and use its stated mass or capacity units to measure or compare the amount.

measurement_angles.evidence: Use a visible angle and degree scale, or compose measured angle parts; the final marker represents the measured angle.

measurement_time.evidence: Set or interpret a visible clock or time number line, including the specified unit and elapsed-time relationship.

measurement_money.evidence: Manipulate coin or money amounts and preserve their values while counting, comparing or solving a transaction.

measurement_conversion.evidence: Connect measures of the same amount in named units and use the stated conversion relationship.

measurement_area_volume.evidence: Build or measure a region or solid with equal units, linking the changed covering or packing state to area, perimeter or volume.

data_graphs.evidence: Build or change a graph or line plot from actual data and use its labels, scale and counts to answer.

geometry_classification.evidence: Sort or connect visible figures by defining spatial attributes, with size, color and orientation varied.

geometry_construction.evidence: Construct or draw the requested figure with actual strokes or placed geometric pieces; a parent checks the defining attributes.

mathematical_drawing.evidence: Draw an actual quantitative model, diagram or graph and record the mathematical labels or steps; a parent checks the representation against the stated relationship.

geometry_coordinates.evidence: Place or move points on visible labeled axes according to ordered pairs, then interpret the resulting location.

classification_matching.evidence: Move or connect pieces using the target category, relationship or repeating structure rather than a decorative action.

phonological_oral.evidence: Hear or see fresh words and record the actual spoken sounds, syllables, rhyme or blending; a parent checks pronunciation and segmentation.

phonics_decoding.evidence: Manipulate graphemes or word parts and read a fresh word aloud; a parent checks the actual sound-to-print decoding.

reading_fluency.evidence: Record an actual reading of a fresh appropriate text; a parent checks accuracy, rate, expression and any requested self-correction.

print_book_features.evidence: Act on actual print, page or book-feature material and demonstrate its function; a parent checks the observed reading behavior.

reading_evidence.evidence: Select and place literal evidence from a complete original passage to support a specific answer or claim.

reading_sequence.evidence: Rebuild events or procedural steps using meaningful temporal or causal relationships in the material.

reading_response.evidence: Create an actual summary, question, explanation, inference or comparison grounded in the supplied complete text; a parent judges the requested reasoning.

reading_multimodal.evidence: Use an actually rendered illustration, diagram, chart or spoken version together with its text to create a grounded response.

vocabulary_relationships.evidence: Sort, connect or edit words in a complete context to show the requested meaning, morphology or relationship.

language_editing.evidence: Assemble or change actual words and sentences so the requested grammatical, punctuation or spelling feature is used.

language_composition.evidence: Compose or revise actual language for the requested meaning, sentence structure, register or effect; a parent checks the open-ended result.

handwriting.evidence: Write the requested letters with actual pointer strokes; a parent checks letter formation rather than accepting typed substitutes.

writing_composition.evidence: Create and revise an actual draft that demonstrates the target writing feature; a parent uses a criterion-specific rubric.

writing_revision.evidence: Change an existing draft in response to a clear goal or feedback, preserving both the initial text and the child-created revision.

writing_research.evidence: Read supplied original source cards, take or organize actual notes and write a sourced answer; a parent checks evidence use and the required research process.

writing_publication.evidence: Produce and save a real written draft using the editor, with parent-observed keyboarding, audience, publication or collaboration requirements as specified.

observed_performance.evidence: Perform the requested action while recording its narration; a parent explicitly confirms the physical or shared performance was observed.
